note: Golf-and-RV resort just outside Sundre, owned by Western RV Country since 2026. Most of the property is privately owned RV lots; the 40-site rental park sits along the #6 fairway of the Deer Nine and its sites are also rented by the season (May 1 - October 15). 18-hole golf course, licensed restaurant overlooking a pond, playground, horseshoe pits and dog park; the resort is gated. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 40-site rental park (30 + 10 pull-throughs) with 15/30/50 A, water and sewer, laundry/showers/wifi, PitchCamp booking (closed for 2026). Wrote booking (2-night minimum, 3 on long weekends), hookups, sites, facilities; note rewritten. NO nightly rate found; seasonal C$5,500 posted. Long-stay: seasonal rentals from the same 40 sites, nightly share unmeasurable.
